text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I ran a bunch of searches online, but
nobody
seems to be talking about me.
Not a soul...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hrm. I still have so much work ahead of
me.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
choice_data_list: 充分、頑張っていると思う
トレーニング量を増やそう！
choice_data_list_en: I think you're working plenty hard.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... I guess that's true. Every popular
mascot
out there has been through a
period of struggle.
choice_data_list: すぐに結果が出るとは限らない
choice_data_list_en: Results don't always come right away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Next race, I'll show everyone. It's going
to be
Machan's grand comeback!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I'll do whatever it takes—even
shave time off
my merch production
schedule.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I just... don't like the thought of
everyone
forgetting about me.
